paragraphs: Actuate sells video analytics that detect guns, intruders and crowds in real time and cut down false alarms. The named buyers are security providers, among them central monitoring stations and alarm receiving centers.

The company says its analytics push video through multiple models to hold down false positive alarms. It runs from a cloud platform meant to work with systems already in place, which the company says avoids on-site hardware upgrades. A camera health service checks cameras continuously and flags blurriness, tilting, obstructions or a camera that has gone offline. Alerts cover threats such as unauthorized access and fire detection.
Reporting is offered as a way to see trends and system performance and to plan from them. Line crossing detection is another of the analytics the site lists.
